name: Distinguishing Range of Tagged Singletons
proof: Every ordinary coordinate i is necessary: the tagged pair $\{i,n+f(i)\}$ and its tag singleton differ only at i. Every tag coordinate $n+\ell$ is necessary as well, because the tag singleton $\{n+\ell\}$ and the empty concept differ only there. Thus all $n+\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ coordinates are required, and querying all of them plainly distinguishes the class.
